preconditions.description: The number of points n and segments m are within the range [1, 100].

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 100 for x in points)
preconditions.description: All point coordinates are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.
There are exactly n distinct point coordinates.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= l <= r <= 100 for l, r in segments)
preconditions.description: All segment boundaries are integers between 0 and 100, with l <= r.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(colors) == n and all(c in (0, 1) for c in colors) and all(abs(sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(points) if l <= x <= r and colors[i] == 0) - sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(points) if l <= x <= r and colors[i] == 1)) <= 1 for l, r in segments))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no solution) or a sequence of n integers (0 or 1) representing colors such that for every segment, the absolute difference between the count of red points (0) and blue points (1) within that segment is at most 1.
